name: Sharkindle
ability: Rough Skin / Flash Fire / Tough Claws (hidden)
look: a red and black land shark on four stubby legs with a toothy grin, sharp yellow eyes, a striped grey dorsal fin and glowing orange shoulder fins
entry: It swims through the ground near lava as easily as a shark through water, its orange fins glowing where they cut through the hot rock. Its bite can dent iron.
how: Wild: very rare in volcanic biomes and badlands, and underground near lava.
